Application screening and shortlisting Document Verification Personal Interview Medical Examination

how_to_apply: Visit the official GMRC website at www.gujaratmetrorail.com.
Register using your name, date of birth, category, mobile number and email address.
Check your registered email for the login passcode.
Log in to the recruitment portal.
Select the Civil post for which you want to apply.
Enter the required information from the latest employment details to the oldest.
Upload the prescribed qualification, experience, age and CTC documents.
Use the preview option to verify all the information.
Submit the application on or before 3 October 2026.
Only online applications will be accepted. Candidates should check all information carefully because the submitted application cannot be edited.
important_instructions: Only experienced candidates who satisfy the prescribed criteria should apply. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease. Possessing the minimum qualification or experience does not guarantee an interview call. All experience must be post-qualification experience. Government, PSU, Railway and Metro Rail employees should apply through the proper channel where applicable. A No Objection Certificate must be submitted on or before the interview date. Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in Gujarat for at least three years and know Gujarati. Selected candidates may be posted in Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat or any other GMRC project in Gujarat. GMRC may offer a lower grade than the post applied for. Candidates should regularly check the official website for corrigenda, addenda and recruitment updates.

content_sections.heading: GMRC Salary Details
content_sections.text: For candidates appointed on deputation, remuneration will be governed by the applicable standard terms and conditions. Additional benefits, group medical coverage and group personal accident insurance will be provided according to GMRC policies.

content_sections.heading: Contract Period
content_sections.text: The initial appointment will be for a minimum period of three years. It may be extended up to five years based on performance and the applicable terms and conditions of GMRC.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification does not specify an application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The GMRC Civil recruitment process will include the following stages: Application screening and shortlisting Document Verification Personal Interview Medical Examination The document verification will be conducted before the interview. Candidates must carry their original certificates. Those who fail to produce the required original documents will not be permitted to attend the interview. The interview will assess the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness. The date, time and venue of the interview will be communicated through the registered email address.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official GMRC website at www.gujaratmetrorail.com . Open the Careers section. Register using your name, date of birth, category, mobile number and email address. Check your registered email for the login passcode. Log in to the recruitment portal. Select the Civil post for which you want to apply. Enter the required information from the latest employment details to the oldest. Upload the prescribed qualification, experience, age and CTC documents. Use the preview option to verify all the information. Submit the application on or before 3 October 2026. Only online applications will be accepted. Candidates should check all information carefully because the submitted application cannot be edited.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Detailed curriculum vitae Matriculation certificate or birth certificate as proof of age SSC and HSC mark sheets All semester or year-wise graduation mark sheets Degree or diploma certificate Experience and service certificates from previous employers Pay-scale or CTC details along with experience certificates Latest CTC breakup for private-sector candidates Appointment letter from the current organization Proof of joining date Latest salary slip Form 16 for the previous three years NOC and APARs for eligible government, PSU and Metro Rail employees Private-sector candidates must upload their latest CTC breakup. Applications submitted without the required CTC details will not be considered for the applied position.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only experienced candidates who satisfy the prescribed criteria should apply. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease. Possessing the minimum qualification or experience does not guarantee an interview call. All experience must be post-qualification experience. Government, PSU, Railway and Metro Rail employees should apply through the proper channel where applicable. A No Objection Certificate must be submitted on or before the interview date. Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in Gujarat for at least three years and know Gujarati. Selected candidates may be posted in Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat or any other GMRC project in Gujarat. GMRC may offer a lower grade than the post applied for. Candidates should regularly check the official website for corrigenda, addenda and recruitment updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GMRC has announced 48 Civil vacancies for Manager, Engineer, Draftsman, Surveyor and other senior positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GMRC Civil Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 3 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for GMRC Civil posts?
faq.answer: Most positions require a B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering. Draftsman and Surveyor posts require a three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age varies from 28 to 62 years, depending on the post and whether the candidate applies through contract, deputation or post-superannuation mode.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for GMRC Civil posts?
faq.answer: The revised IDA pay scales range from Rs.30,000–1,20,000 for Engineer Junior Grade to Rs.1,20,000–2,80,000 for Chief General Manager or General Manager.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for GMRC Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of document verification, personal interview and medical examination.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the GMRC contract?
faq.answer: The initial appointment will be for at least three years and may be extended up to five years based on performance.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply through offline mode?
faq.answer: No. GMRC will accept applications only through the online Careers section of its official website.
